prompt: Composition: Chronological entries with dates on a shared rail, compact media, explicit sequence. Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Libre Baskerville; direct grotesque heading with measured reading serif. Use Spectrum 1-6: page #FAF9FB, text #2D1F27, accent #86241D, secondary surface #EAEFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 80px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 48px, content width at most 960px and item radius 0px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
